name: Adriana Rizzolo
reason: Health rule and scope. Her own site (bodytemple.church, home page) centres on somatic trauma work ('transform trauma responses', 'trauma-informed healing', 'heal trauma' in her Kripalu bio) and adult sex education. Its lead items are a film on female orgasm and ejaculation, the 'It's Not Pee!' course and 'Erotic Mysticism'. The spiritual material (ritual dance, Tantra) cannot be separated from that therapeutic and adult framing.
